references.text: The first census of the tribe of Judah showed 74,600 men, which can be compared with the number 76,500 in this second counting.
Judah was born to Leah, and his name was given because she praised the Lord. This is the origin of the tribe of Judah.
Judah's sons Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah are mentioned here, and their descendants form the basis for the clans counted in Numbers 26.
The story of Judah and his sons, including Perez and Zerah, who are the ancestors of the clans mentioned in the verses before this one.
The preceding verses list the specific clans within the tribe of Judah: Shelah, Perez, Zerah, Hezron, and Hamul, whose total number is summed up here.
